decision: COBR decided to implement household isolation for 14 days and reduce contact advice for individuals over 70.
source_quote: COBR decided that there needed to be further, more stringent measures, and you will recall the household isolation for 14 days, reduced contact advice, over 70s particularly must ensure that they reduce contact.

decision: The decision to lock down should have been made much earlier.
source_quote: "With hindsight, and information we did not have at the time, it is now obvious we should have locked down much earlier."

decision: The UK Government implemented a mandatory lockdown on the 23rd.
source_quote: the mandatory decisions that came thereafter, notably the closure of schools and then the whole legal lockdown on the 23rd.

decision: The period from the 16th to the 23rd was characterized as a ratcheting up of lockdown measures.
source_quote: I see the period from the 16th to the 23rd as essentially a ratcheting up of lockdown.

decision: Schools were to be closed.
source_quote: we took the view on the 20th that we needed to close schools.

decision: All available measures were to be implemented.
source_quote: we need to pull that lever too. Then by the 21st... and therefore decided to go the full measure.

decision: The government decided to go the full measure and pull every lever available to stop the NHS from being overwhelmed.
source_quote: and therefore decided to go the full measure. So it -- and do -- and pull every lever available to us.

decision: Health leaders were asked to make the case for a second national lockdown.
source_quote: I therefore took the step of asking health leaders to make the case for a second national lockdown.

decision: Voices in the health and social care system were corralled to support public health actions.
source_quote: I corralled the voices that I knew would support the -- what was needed in the public health interest.

decision: The National Situation Centre will be fully operational by 2025.
source_quote: The National Situation Centre is developing a biothreats radar which will provide near real-time monitoring of emerging biological threats that may impact the UK, and will be fully operational by 2025.

decision: Additional action was taken on 20th March, including the closure of schools.
source_quote: Additional action was taken on 20th, the closure of schools, ordained by COBR, on the 18th.

decision: Order a zero-based review of the Cabinet Office.
source_quote: ordered a zero-based review of the Cabinet Office

decision: The next substantive hearings will commence in Module 3, the healthcare module, at the beginning of September.
source_quote: The next substantive hearings will commence in Module 3, the healthcare module, at the beginning of September.

decision: The government was advised that the package of measures was at the riskier end of the spectrum and had the potential to increase R above 1.
source_quote: Vallance noted the heavy trailing in the press of the measures the govt has now announced it will relax; said he and Whitty had made clear to the policymakers that this package was at the riskier end of the spectrum (with the potential to increase R above 1), and that they needed to be prepared to re-impose measures if necessary.

decision: The government increased financial support for self-isolation and other benefits.
source_quote: that's why we had the -- not just the £500 for self-isolation payment but also we increased Universal Credit by £1,000, working family tax credit by £1,000, and gave councils a very large budget to deal with those who were most in need of help.

decision: The decision on when to implement the shielding package would be based on advice from the CMO and the CSA.
source_quote: It was noted that the decision on when to implement this package would be based on advice from the CMO and the CSA.

decision: Imposition of a third national lockdown was necessary.
source_quote: there was no option but to impose a third national lockdown.

decision: The report for Module 2, 2A, 2B, and 2C will be published as soon as reasonably possible.
source_quote: I will publish the report for Module 2, 2A, 2B and 2C as soon as we reasonably can.

decision: We need to continue contact tracing, and introduce self contact tracing.
source_quote: "- we need to continue contact tracing, and introduce self contact tracing."

decision: Recommend the XS/XO model for managing crises alongside a taskforce.
source_quote: I will be certainly recommending to whoever the Prime Minister may be that that XS/XO model is a good way of managing that breadth of business, alongside a taskforce.

decision: Enforcement was established as the last resort after the first three Es had been undertaken.
source_quote: That approach, I would suggest, was inherently flexible and the message was simple: enforcement was the last resort after the first three Es had been undertaken.

decision: An action plan for infection control measures was drafted by the department.
source_quote: Yes, the department was drafting what became the action plan.

decision: Different parts of the UK would approach the same problem in different ways due to differences in the epidemiological position and available healthcare facilities.
source_quote: He accepted the suggestion that different parts of the UK would approach the same problem in different ways because of differences in the epidemiological position and available healthcare facilities.

decision: There was an unacceptable absence in communications on Long Covid.
source_quote: There was an unacceptable absence in communications on Long Covid. Indeed, we now understand that there was no government communication strategy for Long Covid.

decision: The witness asserts that the Prime Minister took the ultimate decisions timeously.
source_quote: Yes. Yes.

decision: The witness believes the Prime Minister made the case for his decision in public well.
source_quote: I believe that he made the case for it in public well.

decision: A COBR meeting was held on 2 March.
source_quote: In the end, we had the COBR on the Monday, which I think was 2 March.

decision: Implement plan B to protect the public from the Omicron variant.
source_quote: Steps, you declared to Cabinet, had to be taken to protect the public from the variant. For good precautionary reasons a plan was devised and put in place, which essentially meant moving from the pre-existing plan A to a plan B.

decision: Lessons learned from the first lockdown were to ensure services supporting women and children remained available.
source_quote: We had learned many lessons from the first lockdown... We considered such things as the 'hidden harms' like increased domestic abuse and child abuse and [we] wanted to ensure it was essential that services supporting women and children remained available.

decision: The formal minute of the meeting reflected the Prime Minister's rejection of contingency plans.
source_quote: My Lady, these were not simply flippant comments, they were the policy.

decision: If agreement was not possible on measures to reduce R below 1, there should be funding flexible to allow the devolved governments to take essential public health decisions.
source_quote: She asked that if agreement was not possible on measures to reduce R below 1, there should be funding flexible to allow the devolved governments to take essential public health decisions.

decision: Request an improved analytical function within the Cabinet Office.
source_quote: asked for an improved analytical function

decision: Regulations will be brought in to prohibit staff movement between care homes as a matter of law.
source_quote: According to him, at a Covid-O meeting on 15 September 2020, it was agreed that regulations would be brought in to prohibit staff movement between care homes as a matter of law.

decision: A national lockdown was decided.
source_quote: Well, around this time we did make the decision for a national lockdown.

decision: COBR agreed actions focused on monitoring the emerging risk and joining up with the devolved administrations.
source_quote: COBR agreed actions, focused on monitoring the emerging risk and joining up with the devolved administrations, and made decisions on the triggers for reassessing the UK response, confirming that the Chief Medical Officer would advise on whether or not they had been met.

decision: A national lockdown was agreed by all four nations on 23 March.
source_quote: This includes the 23 March national lockdown agreed by all four nations.

decision: A single report will be produced to address common themes across the devolved nations.
source_quote: I have decided that because of the number of common themes, to save duplication and to try and get the report out as soon as possible, I will address them in a single report.

decision: The government decided to put a lot of money into CAMHS and children's mental health services.
source_quote: that's why we put a lot of money into CAMHS, into children's mental health services, that's why the government decided to have a big catch-up programme -- a big tutoring programme.

decision: Further work and reports were commissioned through Kemi Badenoch.
source_quote: Did you also contribute to the decision that further work and the reports be ultimately commissioned through Kemi Badenoch?

decision: A package of announcements would be put to COBR on Monday [the 16th].
source_quote: It was agreed that a package of announcements would be put to COBR on Monday [the 16th] ...

decision: Care homes should receive free PPE.
source_quote: we decided that they should get free PPE.

decision: COBR decided to close schools from the 20th of March.
source_quote: On the 18th, COBR decided to close schools from the 20th, just in very general terms.
